newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Helicopter crash kills five in Russia's Urals.
newsitem.headline: Helicopter crash kills five in Russia's Urals.

text.p: Five people were killed on Thursday when a passenger helicopter from the local medical service crashed in Russia's Perm region in the Urals, a spokesman for the emergencies ministry said.
The Mi-8 helicopter got caught in a snowstorm and hit a radio mast, bursting into flames and crashing. All five people on board were killed, he said.
